NORAD ID: 40298
Int'l Code: 2014-070A
Launch date: November 6, 2014
Source: Japan (JPN)
Launch site: Orenburg, Russia (OREN)

ASNARO 1 (Advanced Satellite with New System Architecture for Observation) carries an optical camera that can resolve objects as small as a half-meter (20 inches) across. The satellite is designed to send back high-resolution imagery through an advanced X-band radio system. Made by NEC Corp., the satellite is the first in a planned series of small Earth-viewing satellites Japanese officials intend to build for domestic and international customers.
